outputSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing the structured output the agent is expected to produce as its final message. When set AND `agentctl run --output-file <path>` is passed, the CLI extracts JSON from the agent's last assistant message (stripping a single ```json fenced block if present), validates it against this schema, and writes the validated JSON to <path>. Validation failure fails the run with exit 1. Without `--output-file`, this field has no runtime effect — schema validation is gated on a consumer being present. The schema must be an object (the JSON Schema draft 2020-12 boolean-schema shorthand — `true`/`false` — is intentionally NOT supported: `true` is already expressible as `outputSchema: {}` (accept any JSON), and `false` (reject all output) has no use case. Within the object form we do not constrain the meta-schema — the CLI passes the document through to the validator verbatim.

type.description: Which local runtime adapter to dispatch to. `local` is the legacy v0.1.x alias for `local-pi` (the Pi adapter) and stays accepted for backwards compatibility. `local-opencode` routes to the opencode adapter shipped under runtime-opencode/. `local-codex` routes to the codex adapter shipped under runtime-codex/.

requirements.description: Optional capability requirements the runtime must satisfy. Free-form boolean flags. Consumed by `Backend.Resolve()` against the active `RuntimeBinding`'s `spec.selector.capabilities` (v0.3.3+). Default policy is warn-but-proceed: each unmet `requirement: true` emits one wire `warning` event (`kind: unmet_runtime_requirement`) and the run continues. Set `target.strict: true` on the Binding to promote unmet requirements to a hard error before any session.started event. Without `--binding`, requirements are not evaluated (resolver is a no-op pass-through). Note: as of v0.4.0, NO Backend yet enforces capabilities like `sandbox: true` or `restrictedNetwork: true` end-to-end — the matcher trusts the Binding's advertisement. Real enforcement was originally planned for v0.4.5 but is now opportunistic background per the 2026-06-10 roadmap pivot; treat sandbox/network requirements as documentation, not policy, until a future enforcement slice lands. See ROADMAP.md (`Recorded design decisions`). Reserved well-known keys: `streaming`, `sandbox`, `gpu`, `restrictedNetwork`, `ephemeralFilesystem`. Arbitrary additional keys are accepted (e.g. `spark`, `notebookContext`) so capability bundles can advertise their own flags.

guardrails.description: Runtime safety guardrails. Each guardrail can be tuned independently. Absent fields take their default.

hallucinationDetector.description: How the runtime reacts when the assistant writes fabricated tool-call XML (<invoke>, <function_calls>, etc.) in its message text instead of using the real tool channel. `block` (default) emits a wire error event and ends the session with reason=error and a non-zero CLI exit. `warn` emits a wire warning event, scrubs the offending XML from the displayed message text, and lets the session run to completion. `correct` is `warn` plus one corrective re-prompt that asks the model to redo its last message without the fake XML.

observability.description: Observability surface (slice 5.1+). Today this only controls whether agentctl emits OpenTelemetry traces (host + adapter side) and whether prompt/completion content is captured in those spans. Later slices add metrics + structured audit. Absence means OFF: the spec must opt in.

tracing.description: When true, agentctl emits an OTel root span around the run (`agentctl.run`) and the runtime adapter (Pi as of slice 5.3; opencode in slice 5.4) emits per-LLM / per-tool / per-session child spans nested under the host root via the W3C TRACEPARENT delivered through env. All spans use OTel GenAI semantic-convention attributes (`gen_ai.system`, `gen_ai.request.model`, `gen_ai.operation.name`). The OTLP endpoint is selected by the standard `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` env var; if that env var is missing the trace provider runs as a no-op so this field is safe to leave true without an exporter configured. Default: false.

captureContent.description: When true, the runtime adapter attaches the actual prompt messages, completion text, tool-call arguments, and tool-call results as `gen_ai.*` span attributes (per OTel GenAI semconv). Off by default for privacy — only enable on runs shipping to a backend approved to store conversation content. Requires `tracing: true` to have any effect. Default: false.
